report:
Zona koštanog edema prednjeg i srednjeg dijela lateralnog kondila tibije. Ne vidi se frakture.
Koštane apozicije uz rubove lateralnog kondila femura i tibije.
Stanjena femoralna i tibijalna hrskavica, naglašenije u lateralnom dijelu zgloba, gdje se mjestimično vidi povišenje signala čitave debljine femoralne hrskavice /hondromalacija III stupnja/ te zona denudacije tibije uz već opisan koštani edem.
Nema izljeva. 
Prednji križni ligament urednog signala te se prati u kontinuitetu.
Stražnji križni ligament urednog signala te se prati u kontinuitetu.
Medijalni menisk bez znakova degeneracije ili rupture.
Povišen intenzitet signala lateralnog meniska u području stražnjeg roga i prema korpusu, doseže donju artikulacijsku plohu - kompleksna ruptura.
Potpuna ruptura medijalnog kolateralnog ligamenta u proksimalnoj polovici, sa većim edemom priležećih mekih tkiva. 
Lateralni kolateralni ligament se prati u kontinuitetu, bez znakova rupture ili distenzije.
Uredan intenzitet signala hvatišta tetive kvadricepsa i patelarnog ligamenta.
Manja poplitealna cista unutar koje se izdvajaju sitni fragmenti (slobodna osteohondralna tijela?). 
Uredna je kongruencija zglobnih tijela femoropatelarnog zgloba. Na prijelazu lateralne i medijalne fasete patele povišen intenzitet signala hrskavice do polovice debljine. Veća količina izljeva femoropatelarno, suprapatelarno i u lateralnom recesusu. Ruptura medijalnog femoropatelarnog ligamenta na hvatištu za patelu. Edem potkožnog masnog tkiva anteromedijalno.

Normal knee joint alignment.   No fracture is seen.  
  No osteocartilagenous lesion is detected.  
  No focal bone marrow edema is noted.  
  Minimal amount of joint effusion is seen.  
  
  MCL is intact.  Small peripheral vertical tear at posterior horn of the medial meniscus is noted.  
  FCL, popliteus and biceps femoris tendons are preserved.       
   Normal shape with preserved signal of the lateral meniscus is observed.   
  
  Normal course with preserved signal of the ACL is noted.  The PCL is intact.  
  PF joint surface is preserved.   No subchondral bone lesion is noted.  
   Quadriceps and patellar tendons are preserved.  Small peripheral vertical tear at posterior horn of the medial meniscus.

In the medial compartment,  
 Articular cartilage at weightbaring medial femoral condyle and medial tibial plateau are preserved.  
  Bony marrow SI at medial femoral condyle and medial tibial plateau are preserved. 
  Medial collateral ligament: Preserved. 
  Medial gastrocnemius: Preserved.  
  Semimenbranosus tendon: Unremarkable.   
  Semitendinosus tendon: preserved. 
  Pes anserine tendon: preserved.  
  Baker cyst: not seen. 
  
 Lateral compartment 
  Preservation of cartilage at weightbaring lateral femoral condyle and lateral tibial plateau.  
  Bony marrow SI at lateral femoral condyle and lateral tibial plateau are preserved. 
  Lateral meniscus; Minimal illdefine increase fluid SI but no thickening at anterior root of lateral meniscus; could be artifact or contusional injury. 
  Lateral collateral ligament: Mild thickening and increase SI in T2WI at femoral attachment site. 
  Popliteus tendon: Preserved. 
  Poplitiofibular ligament ; is unidentified. 
  Meniscofemoral ligament: preserved. 
  Biceps femoris: Unremarkable. 
  Iliotibial band: Intact. 
  Lateral gastrocnemius: intact. 
  Tibiofibular joint; unremarkable. 
  
 Patellofemoral joint 
  Preserve marrow SI within patella and femur with minimal joint effusion. 
  Visualized thin horizontal line low SI in T2WI at suprapatellar region and infrapatellar region (arrow in image 33serie 401, image 11 and 13serie 701); suprapatellar and infrapatellar plica is suggested. 
  No definite chondrosis at medial and lateral facet articular cartilage.  
  Quadriceps tendon; intact 
  Patella tendon; intacte infact and within normal alignment.  
  Medial and latera patellofemoral retinaculum; preserved. 
  
 Intercondylar notch 
  PCL: Intact. 
  ACL: Intact. 
  Minimal joint effusion.  
  
 The other surrounding musculature and neurovascular structure is unremarkable.  
 Few reactive lymph node at popliteal fossa region.  Visualized thin  horizontal line low SI in T2WI at suprapatellar region and infrapatellar region (arrow in image 33serie 401, image 11 and 13serie 701); suprapatellar (intact75 cm in maximal thickness) and infrapatellar plica (intact59 cm in maximal thickness and discontinuous of fiber). Infrapatellar plica injury is suspected.  
  Minimal illdefine increase fluid SI but no thickening at anterior root of lateral meniscus; could be artifact or contusional injury. 
  Mild sprain at femoral attachment site of lateral collateral ligament. 
  Minimal joint effusion.  
  No evidence of osteochondral defect.

МР находка: МР данни за стрес фрактура под главата на фибулата. Няма данни за дислокация. Изобразява се фрактурна линия през напречника на костта, около която се вижда изразен оток на костния мозък.  Тибия, патела – с нормална форма. Наличие на малък контузионен костно-мозъчен едем в медиалния кондил на фемура. Няма данни за ставен излив. Нормално изобразяване на менискусите. Кръстните връзки са със запазена цялост. Ставният хрущял е интактен. Колатерални лигаменти – без особености. Ретинакулуми – б.о. Лигамент на пателата, сухожилие на м. квадрицепс феморис – без особености. Заключение: MР данни за стрес фрактура на фибулата. Не се намират други патологични изменения в дясното коляно.

The study reveals normal knee joint alignment, no definite fracture line noted.  
 Diffuse subcutaneous edema along anterior aspect of the knee to prepatellar region. 
  
  There is thickened, hyperintense mid to distal ACL with mild laxity of ACLobserved.  
  Buckling PCL with intact ligament is noted.  
    
  There is mild hyperintense proximal MCL.   
   Thin horizontal tear through inferior surface at posterior horn of the medial meniscus is detected.  
  
   Thickened hyperintense proximal FCL and mild hyperintense proximal popliteus tendon are observed.  
 Biceps femoris tendon is intact.   No definite tear of the lateral meniscus is noted.  
   Minimal joint effusion is seen.   
   PF joint, articular cartilage appears unremarkable.  
   Quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact.    Highgrade partial tear of ACL . 
     MCL sprain  
     Thin horizontal tear through inferior surface at posterior horn of the medial meniscus  
     Proximal FCL sprain

In the medial compartment, the meniscus is not torn and there is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury. 
 The lateral compartment, the meniscus is not torn and there is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury. 
 The patellofemoral joint, the patellar and trochlear cartilage appears congruent without chondral lesion. The medial patellofemoral ligament is intact  
 In the intercondylar notch, the anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments are intact There is no tibial translation. 
 The medial collateral ligament complexes are intact The posteromedial oblique ligament is intact  
 The lateral collateral ligament complexes are intact The popliteofibular ligament is intact The meniscopopliteal fascicles are intact  
 The extensor mechanism is normal.  
 No knee effusion is present. The surrounding musculature is normal. There is no fracture or bone contusion.   Normal MR examination of the right knee.  Specifically, there is no evidence of meniscal, ligamentous, or articular cartilage abnormality.
